# 10KC (Ten Thousand Coffees)

> > 10KC is an enterprise mentorship and social learning platform that automates talent development through intelligent matching, structured pathways, and comprehensive analytics.

10KC provides organizations with mentoring software to drive employee engagement, career development, and leadership growth. The platform serves enterprise clients including Nike, Spring Health, Thomson Reuters, and RBC with features like smart matching algorithms, mentoring pathways, discussion guides, and detailed ROI analytics.

## Key Topics

- mentorship software
- smart matching algorithm
- talent development

## Core Features

- [Smart Matching Algorithm | Mentor Matching](https://www.tenthousandcoffees.com/product/smart-matching-algorithm): Smart matching algorithm automating mentor-mentee pairing and connections
- [Mentoring Pathways](https://www.tenthousandcoffees.com/product/mentoring-pathways): 10KC Mentoring Pathways feature for end-to-end program deployment
- [Mentoring Experiences](https://www.tenthousandcoffees.com/product/mentoring-experiences): Multiple mentoring experience types including office hours and introductions
- [Mentorship Reporting & Analytics](https://www.tenthousandcoffees.com/product/reporting-and-analytics): Analytics dashboard for tracking mentoring ROI and program impact metrics
- [Mentoring Discussion Guides](https://www.tenthousandcoffees.com/product/mentoring-discussion-guides): Pre-built discussion guide library for focused mentoring conversations
- [Automated Mentoring Communications](https://www.tenthousandcoffees.com/product/automated-mentoring-communications): Automated program communications reducing manual mentoring program tasks
- [Integrations](https://www.tenthousandcoffees.com/product/integrations): HRIS, SSO and collaboration tool integrations for seamless program management
